## Goal

Explore MCP discovery and analysis as a future layer on top of OpenMesh observability data.

## Scope

- MCP endpoint health checks
- Capability discovery
- Tool inventory generation
- Authentication analysis
- Permission visibility
- Dependency and trust-chain mapping
- Security posture insights

## Non-Goals

- Do not bypass the OpenMesh event pipeline.
- Do not implement framework-specific integrations in this work item.
